optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Fraud Analytics Analyst, Card Fraud Detection
professionalSummary: Three years of experience as a Fraud Analytics Analyst in a card issuer’s fraud detection team, responsible for analysing flagged‑transaction outcomes, proposing rule threshold changes with expected alert volumes, and coordinating with the fraud operations desk.  Demonstrated ability to prepare comprehensive monthly fraud performance packs, monitor model alert precision, and document rule change limitations and hand‑over conditions.  Proven track record of collaborating with fraud strategy managers and model owners to ensure effective fraud detection and cost‑controlled rule adjustments.
experienceHighlights: Analyzed flagged‑transaction outcomes weekly and proposed rule threshold changes with quantified alert volume projections; all changes approved by the fraud strategy manager.
Prepared monthly fraud performance packs detailing fraud losses, alert volumes, false positive rates, and impact of rule changes.
Monitored fraud model alert precision on a weekly dashboard, identified two drift cases, and logged them with model owners.
Coordinated rule changes with the fraud operations desk, documenting responsibilities and hand‑over conditions.
Authored limitation sections for each rule change, ensuring clear boundaries and operational clarity.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Rule change proposal with expected alert volumes and approval record; monthly fraud performance pack; model monitoring log extract for two drift cases, all referenced in fraud tools for verification.

role.roleTitle: Fraud Analytics Analyst, Card Fraud Detection

evidence.text: Fraud analytics analyst in a card issuer's fraud detection team for three years, analysing flagged-transaction outcomes each week and proposing rule threshold changes with their expected alert volumes; the changes were approved by the fraud strategy manager.
Work sample: one rule change proposal with its expected alert volumes and approval record
Prepared the monthly fraud performance pack for the fraud strategy manager, covering fraud losses, alert volumes, false positive rates and the effect of the month's rule changes.
Monitored the fraud model's alert precision on the weekly monitoring dashboard and raised two drift cases to the model owners, both recorded in the model monitoring log.
Coordinated each rule change with the fraud operations desk through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which belonged to the desk supervisor.
Wrote the limitation section of each rule change note and the hand-over conditions for the desk.
